name: serpapi_google_shopping_light
description: Search Google Shopping across multiple retailers through SerpApi's fast lightweight structured engine. Use for 'shop for...', 'compare prices for...', 'find the best price on...', 'Google Shopping for...', 'where can I buy...', 'show products under...', sale checks, free-shipping offers, and multi-store purchase research. Returns merchant, current and prior price, rating, review count, delivery, direct or Google product link, thumbnail, sale tags, pagination, and—when available—the exact immersive product token needed by serpapi_google_immersive_product for specifications, reviews, variants, and richer store details. It can use JARVIS_DEFAULT_LOCATION or JARVIS_DEFAULT_POSTAL_CODE when location is omitted. Prefer this for broad retailer discovery and as the prerequisite product finder for Google Immersive Product; use serpapi_amazon_search for Amazon-specific Prime, delivery, stock, or ASIN details. Prices may describe different variants or seller terms, so verify the selected offer before purchase.

query.description: Required Google Shopping query. Include product, model, size, color, or other variant details needed for a fair price comparison.

location.description: Optional city-level search origin such as Austin, Texas, United States. Defaults to the current mode's Jarvis location or postal code when configured. Cannot be combined with uule.

uule.description: Advanced Google-encoded location. Cannot be combined with location.

country.description: Optional two-letter Google Shopping country code such as us, uk, or fr.

language.description: Optional two-letter interface language such as en, es, or fr.

google_domain.description: Google domain such as google.com or google.co.uk. Default google.com.

min_price.description: Optional lower price bound in the selected market's currency.

max_price.description: Optional upper price bound in the selected market's currency.

sort_by.description: Result order. Default relevance. Price sorting compares the returned listings, which may represent different variants.

free_shipping.description: Return only offers marked with free shipping. Default false.

on_sale.description: Return only offers marked on sale. Default false.

small_business.description: Return only products from sellers Google identifies as small businesses. Default false.

start.description: Result offset for pagination. Use next_start from a prior response. Default 0.

max_results.description: Maximum normalized offers to return across regular, inline, and categorized shopping sections. Default 10.

no_cache.description: Bypass SerpApi's one-hour exact-parameter cache. Default false; cached searches are free.

extra_params.description: Advanced non-reserved Google Shopping Light parameters passed through to SerpApi. Core query, location, price, sort, seller filters, pagination, cache, and output controls cannot be overridden.

include_raw.description: Include the full SerpApi JSON response for debugging. Default false.

availability.setup_hint: Set SERP_API_KEY in the active mode env file.
